title: Sandiganbayan denies bail petition of Marcoleta over P75-M plunder case

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Senator Rodante Marcoleta and his co-accused will remain detained at the Quezon City Male Dormitory as the Sandiganbayan Third Division denied their separate bail petitions over their P75-million plunder case which stemmed from a campaign donation. According to the Third Division, the resolution was penned by Justice Ronald Moreno and was promulgated on Monday, November 23. READ: Marcoleta, 3 co-accused seek dismissal of P75-M plunder case “The court denied the motion for bail of Senator Rodante D. Marcoleta and the respective petitions for bail of Aristotle B.
